eyebrow: A verified exact result — one iteration, two marked items
code:
uniform superposition = [0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5]
after oracle            = [0.5, -0.5, 0.5, -0.5]

inner product <s|oracle_state> = 0.5(0.5)+0.5(-0.5)+0.5(0.5)+0.5(-0.5) = 0
final state after diffusion     = [-0.5, 0.5, -0.5, 0.5]
probabilities                   = [0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25]
caption: Exactly uniform — identical to the starting distribution. One iteration produced zero net amplification.

eyebrow: Why this happens, and what to do about it

steps.label: The diffusion step scales with that inner product
steps.sub: Half marked, half unmarked makes the positive and negative contributions cancel exactly to zero

steps.label: The general formula depends on M, not just N
steps.sub: pi/4 * sqrt(N/M) — guessing M wrong can erase any improvement

steps.label: The real fix
steps.sub: Compute the iteration count from your actual M and loop that many times
